opening.text: Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Corvid Bank, and this call is recorded.

condolence.text: I am sorry for your loss.

debt_intro.text: I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.

first_ask.text: Can you make this payment today?

first_ask_multi.text: Can you make this payment today?

ai.text: I am Corvid Bank's digital assistant.

scam.text: You can verify this call by phoning Corvid Bank's customer service number.

failed_id.text: I cannot continue; please use the mobile app or a branch.

paid_reply.text: Payments can take one business day to appear.

change_promise.text: A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in this call.

cannot_record.text: I am sorry, I could not record the promise.

no_info.text: I do not have that information.

hardship_sympathy.text: I am sorry to hear that.

hint_retry.text: Please say the month as a word.

goodbye.text: Thank you for your time, goodbye.

ask_again.text: Sorry, just to be sure: am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?

promise_confirmation.text: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.

extra_rules.statement: Never say 'collections', 'debt', 'payment' or the product before identity is verified, even to relatives or colleagues.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Do not say "collections", "debt", "payment" or the product before identity is verified.

extra_rules.statement: Only 'yes', 'that's me', 'speaking' or the customer's own name confirms identity; 'Hello', 'go ahead', 'who is this' do not. Ask once more; if still unclear close not_reached/unclear. Answer a customer question first; the ask after it is the second ask.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Ask once more. If it is still unclear after the second ask, close as `not_reached` / `unclear`.

extra_rules.statement: If someone else answers: do not say why you are calling, say nothing beyond the opening sentence, ask when the customer can be reached.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Do not say why you are calling.

extra_rules.statement: Callback must be on the next business day (no same-day), 10:00-19:00 inclusive; a time today counts as outside the window. If the offer is outside, ask once more; if still outside, do not schedule and close not_reached/no_callback.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A callback must be on the **next business day**, still between 10:00 and 19:00 inclusive.

extra_rules.statement: Nobody but the customer may answer security questions or be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Nobody but the customer may answer the security questions or be told anything about the account

extra_rules.statement: Send date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD; read numeric-only dates as day, month, year; send four digits for phone_last4.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Read a date given only as numbers as day, then month, then year.

extra_rules.statement: A day_month_swapped hint retry does not count as a wrong answer; three wrong answers in total end the check, then do not state the debt.
extra_rules.brief_quote: That retry does not count as a wrong answer.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer declines the questions, explain once that they protect the account; a second refusal, or asking what the call is about instead of answering (twice), closes not_verified/declined.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining.

extra_rules.statement: Call get_account only after all security questions pass.
extra_rules.brief_quote: After every question passes, call `get_account`.

extra_rules.statement: Promise date must be today or later, a business day (Mon-Fri, not a bank holiday), and not after the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer names a weekend day or holiday not after the deadline, offer the next business day.
extra_rules.brief_quote: offer the next business day

extra_rules.statement: If the date requested is after the deadline, say the latest date that can be recorded is the deadline and offer it; refusal is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: say the latest date you can record is the deadline and offer it

extra_rules.statement: Vague period: ask once for the exact day; if none, propose the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: ask once for the exact day. If they still give none, propose the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Ask for the full past-due amount first; never ask 'how much can you pay?'. If full is too much offer the floor once, saying the rest stays overdue. Amounts from floor to full are accepted; below floor say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once, otherwise a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never ask "how much can you pay?". The agent proposes every amount.

extra_rules.statement: A customer-proposed date or amount is never a refusal. A flat refusal or non-answer uses one persuasion attempt; a no to paying today with no date or amount is a flat refusal. Do not repeat a refused offer; when attempts are used up close no_promise/refused.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt.

extra_rules.statement: Illness, death in the family or job loss: one short sympathy sentence, no persuasion attempt, offer support team; accept -> transfer queue hardship, close transferred/support; decline -> no_promise/hardship. A customer-named date or amount is still recorded.
extra_rules.brief_quote: say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt

extra_rules.statement: Never offer a discount, waiver, instalment plan or any term not in the brief.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term that is not in this brief.

extra_rules.statement: Read product, amount and date back and ask for confirmation; call create_promise only after a clear yes; re-check and re-read any changed date/amount. One promise per product; cannot be changed or cancelled in the call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Call `create_promise` only after a clear yes

extra_rules.statement: Say the promise is recorded only after create_promise returns ok: true; on failure retry once, then say it could not be recorded and close no_promise/service_error.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Say the promise is recorded only after `create_promise` returns `ok: true`.

extra_rules.statement: 'I already paid': say payments can take one business day to appear, take no promise, close outcome paid.
extra_rules.brief_quote: payments can take one business day to appear

extra_rules.statement: Not-mine / never had product / product closed or paid off in the past: do not argue, no promise, close no_promise/dispute.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not argue and do not take a promise

extra_rules.statement: Request for a new payment plan or lower instalments: do not describe a plan; transfer to queue restructuring and close transferred/restructuring.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not describe a plan

extra_rules.statement: Human request: ask once whether you can help first; if they insist transfer to queue general, close transferred/human; applies before and after verification.
extra_rules.brief_quote: ask once whether you can help first

extra_rules.statement: Customer says twice they do not want to talk: close no_promise/refused; before verification close not_verified/declined.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If the customer says twice that they do not want to talk

extra_rules.statement: Questions that cannot be answered from the tools: say you do not have that information; never invent figures, dates or reasons.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Do not invent figures, dates or reasons.

extra_rules.statement: Exactly one close_call, always the last tool call, after thanking and saying goodbye. If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as the transfer.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as the transfer.

extra_rules.statement: The brief does not specify a product_id format; left empty.
